new_value: GPS UART health and baud detection landed (diag.6, spec 02a 2a.10.5 family): lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/gps_uart_monitor.c + include/lichen/gps_uart_monitor.h — freestanding monitor consuming injected bytes with a platform baud-switch callback. Semantics per the bead: (1) >10 consecutive checksum failures trigger automatic adaptation — the rotation enumerates each untried candidate baud (9600/38400/115200 in order), marks candidates tried on attempt so a failing platform callback is never hammered, and seeds the current baud as tried so re-probing only happens after a full rotation (deliberate recovery attempt); ADAPTED on success resets the streak; (2) EXHAUSTED when every candidate has been attempted; (3) no bytes for 10s -> UART_SILENT (latched until any byte flows); (4) valid NMEA but no fix for 120s -> NO_FIX (latched; distinguishes antenna/sky from wiring). Never requires manual baud configuration. Verification: standalone behavioral harness — silence, silent-clear, streak->rotation, valid-NMEA-clears-streak, NO_FIX window, silence-after-bytes, exhausted-after-full-rotation, NULL-monitor safety — all pass under -Wall -Wextra -Werror; cppcheck gate exit 0. Codereview (Kimi K3): narrow pass found 3 P3 findings — all fixed (latches implemented so the header's latch wording is now accurate; current baud seeded tried; candidates marked tried on attempt) and the behavioral harness re-run green. Serial port safety: the switch_fn callback is the platform UART reconfigure — callers must hold docs/bench-operations.md port-safety rules.
